opening.argument: The visible sequence shows ordinary Best Buy shopping: a cart with a tablet and gift-card banner, checkout with delivery choices and product totals, payment fields, and an order-confirmation page. These are observable retail steps, not evidence of a deceptive outcome. The description says “be the winner” and directs viewers to click a link, but the supplied material does not establish that language as an endorsed offer or show a required payment or credential request connected to it. Handwritten material does not alter the retail context when its author, meaning, and relationship to the checkout remain unclear. On this record, the browsing and checkout are clear; a scam mechanism is not.
